Hi Samir,

Thanks again for agreeing to speak with our team about Echosys Health's work with Redwood. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute discovery interview to capture the customer story, confirm metrics we can cite, and get permission to record a short testimonial.

High-level purpose: capture the product impact narrative (before/after), get a few illustrative metrics, and record a 10–12 minute customer quote. Not a polished on-camera shoot — remote interview + short recorded audio.

Proposed dates (PT):
- Tue May 18, 11:00–11:45 AM PT
- Wed May 19, 9:30–10:15 AM PT
- Thu May 20, 2:00–2:45 PM PT

If none of those work, please suggest a couple of alternatives. Attached is a short draft agenda and a media release we typically ask customers to sign for permission to publish the case study.

Rough agenda: intros (5m), impact metrics & use cases (20m), outcomes and customer quote (15m), next steps (5m).

Please let me know who from your team should join (stakeholders and their titles) so we can include them in the calendar invite. Also: are you comfortable with Redwood recording the session and using the audio/quote in a written case study? If so, we'll send the media release for signature.

Thanks — look forward to coordinating.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai

Thanks Samir — booked for Tue May 18 at 11:00 AM PT. Calendar invite will follow (I've tentatively invited Daniel and Tara based on Samir's note).

Priya — attaching a slightly expanded agenda that includes explicit ROI/integration questions and a short recording consent paragraph we typically read at the top of the call. If you prefer specific language changes, let me know and we can adapt.

Draft interview questions (excerpt):
- What problem were you trying to solve before Redwood?
- How did you evaluate/choose Redwood?
- Can you share concrete metrics (time saved, cost reduction, latency improvements)?
- How long did the integration take and who was involved?
- Can you describe a specific internal workflow that changed as a result?
- Would you be willing to provide a 1–2 sentence quote we can use in the case study?

Recording consent: we will record audio and take notes. Redwood will share the draft case study with your team for review; we will not publish direct quotes until you sign off.

Attachments: redwood_case_study_agenda_v1.pdf (updated), redwood_media_release_draft.docx

If it's helpful, Marissa from our team will run the interview and Jonas will join to capture metrics and product details.

Best,
Sofia
